profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ LinkedIn
profile.summary:
🚀 Software Engineer and Tech Lead with over 8 years of experience, offering professional experience in the full software development lifecycle, from concept through delivery of cutting edge applications. I thrive on building visionary software products and platforms, connecting people with each other and the processes and technologies needed to launch (and grow) digital products and services at scale - with strong troubleshooting skills, ability to craft cost-effective, efficient, scalable solutions, and exceptional cross-functional leadership, collaboration, and communication.

📚I have a background in Computer Science, with a degree from Princeton University, where I graduated Summa Cum Laude and conducted research under Dr. Jennifer Rexford in computer networking.

🛠️ Technical Proficiencies
* Python | Java | C# | Data Pipelines (Spark, Flink, Presto) | Stream Processing (Kafka, Samza, Beam) | SQL/NoSQL databases (RDBMS, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Azure Blob/Table storage, Espresso, Venice) |  Security/Privacy/Compliance (GDPR, DMA) | Azure | Machine Learning (sklearn, pandas) | Caching (Couchbase, Redis) | Data Serialization (Json, Avro, Protobuf)

💡Areas of Expertise
* Distributed Systems | Backend Engineering | API Design | Microservices | Databases | Data Engineering | Data Pipelines | Multithreading | Engineering Leadership | Project Management | Prototyping | Mentorship | Algorithms/Data Structures | Debugging | Code/Design Review | Ads | Agentic workflows | Data Analysis | Continuous Process Improvement | Event-Driven Architecture | Statistics | Probability | Big Data | Finance

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Lead for Feed Content Platform (Knowledge Marketplace)

Building data platforms that power recommendations across LinkedIn's Feed - including feature generation, candidate retrieval and ranking, model serving and experimentation, and data pipelines (Kafka, Spark, Airflow). 

Synthesizing expertise in data engineering with backend distributed systems to improve feed relevance and accelerate experimentation velocity, driving top-line business metrics through increased engagement.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Lead for LinkedIn Marketing Solutions Ad APIs

▸ Launched Social Data and Insights API Beta: Enables brands to build actionable insights from conversations on LinkedIn via real-time stream and historical data. Designed and led compliance notification system for clients to maintain GDPR and contractual data compliance requirements, aligning with legal, privacy, and security teams to ensure member trust

▸ Reduced developer friction by launching Content API: Enables API partners to manage sponsored (ad) and organic content - with versioning, more intuitive schemas, and fewer API calls, adopted by 100+ partners and driving over $250MM/yr. Worked cross-functionally with product, marketing, and partners to drive API requirements

▸ Improved quality of data schemas across the company as member of the Data Model Review Committee, defining rules for and reviewing over 100 data models (tracking, services, database) 

▸ Building the next-generation of targeted ads by joining Generative AI with Social Listening to create dynamic, AI-generated ad copies using trending topics to increase relevance. Driving alignments with product and AI teams to ensure high quality results.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Office Apps Services and Identity at Scale (OASIS)

▸ Building, managing, and improving critical microservices serving over 3M requests/sec that enable Office native clients across all platforms to:
 1) Find recent documents across cloud-backed sources (20% latency reduction)
 2) Authenticate users and discover locations to open and save documents
 3) Roam user settings  (50% COGS reduction)
 4) Deliver URLs based on app, platform, build, and environment

▸ Built data pipeline to process 2B requests/day from Office clients to calculate month-month metrics that provide insight into growth (DAU/MAU) and create financial value (COGS) while following regulatory compliance (GDPR) and customer SLA

▸ Re-envisioned the way Office services are integrated to support air gapped clouds by decoupling and integrating components at a lower-level

▸ Prevented future Colonial Pipeline hack by building API to secure data flow and improved security and privacy of customer data using cryptography and PII log detection

▸ Compartmentalized code shared by microservices for smoother migration to newer APIs
